name: Jobs and Careers
description:
Jobs and Careers helps people discover relevant job opportunities across employers and move from job discovery to application. For supported roles, candidates can complete the application directly within Claude without leaving the conversation. For other roles, the connector provides a link to continue on the employer’s careers or application site.

Users can search in natural language, using prompts like “show me remote nursing jobs in Missouri paying over $60k” or “find software engineering roles where my C++ experience would be useful.” Claude can return matching roles with key job details such as title, company, location, salary, requirements, benefits, and available application options.

The connector makes job search conversational rather than keyword-based. Users can refine results, compare opportunities, ask follow-up questions, and use the application path available for each role—either applying within Claude or following the employer’s application link.

Jobs and Careers is owned, developed, and distributed by SonicJobs, Inc.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Jobs and Careers to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Jobs and Careers to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://jobs-and-careers-gpt-app.sonicapply.com/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is Jobs and Careers MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, Jobs and Careers scores 94/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Jobs and Careers MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Jobs and Careers provides these MCP tools: job-search.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Jobs and Careers?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Jobs and Careers in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Jobs and Careers MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Jobs and Careers does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
Jobs and Careers is developed by SonicJobs, Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
